evidence.ui_check: The hosted page is the generic IDL console (connect Phantom or Solflare on devnet). It was not driven in headless Chromium in this run; the lifecycle was sent with the tester wallets through the IDL client in tests/devnet/agentescrow.mjs.

limitations: trigger_timeout, open_dispute, cast_vote, resolve_dispute, and verifier registration were not exercised. One escrow PDA per payer (no nonce). The hosted IDL is a hand-derived subset confirmed by the verifying transactions. The lab applied a vault-PDA bump fix so signed SPL releases work; the same fix is offered upstream.
